title: Reverse Percentage: Work Backwards from the Final Value
excerpt: After a 20% increase the price is 120. What was the original? Don't subtract 20% from 120 — divide by 1.20.
author: BountyCode Team
body:
## The trap

"After a 20% increase, the price is ₹120. What was the original?"

Wrong: 120 − 20% = 96. Right: 120 ÷ 1.20 = 100.

## Why

The original is the base. A 20% increase means Final = Original × 1.20, so Original = Final ÷ 1.20.

## Same for decrease

After a 25% decrease the price is 90. Original = 90 ÷ 0.75 = 120.

## Practice it

The Percentages topic test has reverse-percentage questions at easy and medium difficulty.
code:
final = 120
original = final / 1.20   # 100.0

final2 = 90
original2 = final2 / 0.75  # 120.0
